criteria.name: All finite path words walked
criteria.statement: In any nontrivial reachable cycle, arbitrarily long distinct path words exist by repetition, so literal exhaustion of all finite path words has no finite terminal stage.

criteria.name: All states visited
criteria.statement: Visiting every chirality presentation does not necessarily visit every structurally distinct transition or History class.

criteria.name: All directed adjacency edges realized
criteria.statement: Finite structural criterion: every admissible directed local transition class has appeared at least once.

criteria.name: All History-equivalence classes realized
criteria.statement: Complete History is exhaustion of all admissible equivalence classes under an explicitly declared History quotient.

criteria.name: No new admissible History-distinct continuation remains
criteria.statement: Terminal condition at realized state/history H when every currently admissible continuation belongs to an already-realized History-equivalence class.
